answer: A neighbor quorum blocks fake identities: a newcomer claims one reef plot and locks a 70-credit bond. Four established neighbors countersign on the mesa registry with walnut seals at 40 credits each; each caps at three per epoch, and a reused seal burns the bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 230,000 against a 40,000 pool, net loss 190,000. Rented seals fail: star clusters get flagged. An honest agent pays 160 once, keeping bond and share.
